goal: Test whether one predeclared confidence statement for same-state twins and two positive lags improves quantitative inference over the actual two-stage and extra-lag implementations
source_model_and_baselines: calibrated_benchmark.specification/model/calibration_records/oracle/analyze; same model and predeclared baselines, independent new seed

joint.selection: Fixed before these held-out records; prior model and parameter inherited from earlier work; no current-data optimization
joint.same_state_contract: Two noninvasive fresh conditionally independent binary readings at the same unchanged stationary hidden state, using exactly the same detector channel as positive-lag records
joint.record_contract: Fresh independent uniform stationary preparation for each pair; within-pair noise conditionally independent
joint.entropy_denominator: (2*s*sqrt(1)+sqrt(2))^2; ideal lag0 contributes sampling variance but no Q-versus-additive-reversible path divergence

cases.name: invalid_calibration
cases.contract: outside: detector gain changes between lag0 and positive-lag records

baseline_contract.two_stage: Call calibrated_benchmark.analyze unchanged: alpha_calibration=.025, alpha_science=.025, coefficients(1.52,-1), calibrated polygon; report both Pinsker and nonlinear actual implementations
baseline_contract.extra_lag: Call the same analyze output for predeclared optimized shifted-cubic coefficients(-.1156,.68,-1), alpha=.05, quotas8000/8000/4000 at lags1/2/3
baseline_contract.legacy_extra_lag: Retain the original(-4/9,4/3,-1) comparator returned by analyze
baseline_contract.paired_comparison: All methods share identical lag1 and lag2 records. Joint and two-stage share identical same-state twin records. The extra-lag arm substitutes an independent4000-pair lag3 menu for those twins.

unmeasured: hardware verification of same-state same-channel twin contract
costs.qualification: Record and readout matched comparison, with unequal declared evolution times. No calibrated joule advantage; unmeasured overhead is not zero.

outputs: pointwise95percent Clopper-Pearson Monte Carlo detection intervals
joint contrast and two-stage region confidence coverage
all-dataset entropy-lower-bound statistics and paired differences
scope: Synthetic finite-model study; established moment/Markov/entropy ingredients; no external peer review, physical data, universal power ranking or total-dissipation recovery
